mn31:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Nādike viharati Giñjakāvasathe.
mn31:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo Gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.
mn31:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena Gosiṅgasālavanadāyo ten' upasaṅkami.
mn31:3.2: Addasā kho dāyapālo Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn31:3.5: sant' ettha tayo kulaputtā attakāmarūpā viharanti,
mn31:4.1: Assosi kho āyasmā Anuruddho dāyapālassa Bhagavatā saddhiṃ mantayamānassa,
mn31:4.5: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho yen' āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantañ-ca Nandiyaṃ āyasmantañ-ca Kimbilaṃ etad-avoca:
mn31:4.6: Abhikkamath' āyasmanto, abhikkamath' āyasmanto, satthā no Bhagavā anuppatto ti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn31:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo Bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā
mn31:5.2: eko Bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi eko āsanaṃ paññāpesi eko pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhāpesi.
mn31:5.5: Te pi kho āyasmanto Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
mn31:5.6: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ Bhagavā etad-avoca:
mn31:5.7: Kacci vo Anuruddhā khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci piṇḍakena na kilamathāti. --
mn31:5.8: Khamanīyaṃ Bhagavā, yapanīyaṃ Bhagavā, na ca mayaṃ bhante piṇḍakena kilamāmāti. --
mn31:6.1: Kacci pana vo Anuruddhā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathāti. --
mn31:6.2: Taggha mayaṃ bhante samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharāmāti. --
mn31:6.3: Yathākathaṃ pana tumhe Anuruddhā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathāti. --
mn31:7.2: Lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,
mn31:7.4: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante imesu āyasmantesu mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ āvī c' eva raho ca,

mn31:7.9: So kho ahaṃ bhante sakaṃ cittaṃ nikkhipitvā imesaṃ yeva āyasmantānaṃ cittassa vasena vattāmi.
mn31:7.10: Nānā hi kho no bhante kāyā ekañ-ca pana maññe cittan-ti.

mn31:8.2: Kacci pana vo Anuruddhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathāti. --
mn31:9.1: Taggha mayaṃ bhante appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharāmāti. --
mn31:9.2: Yathākathaṃ pana tumhe Anuruddhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathāti. --
mn31:9.3: Idha bhante amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, so āsanāni paññāpeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhāpeti.
mn31:9.4: Yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, sace hoti bhuttāvaseso sace ākaṅkhati bhuñjati, no ce ākaṅkhati appaharite vā chaḍḍeti appāṇake vā udake opilāpeti.
mn31:9.5: So āsanāni paṭisāmeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ paṭisāmeti, avakkārapātiṃ paṭisāmeti, bhattaggaṃ sammajjati.
mn31:9.6: Yo passati pānīyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojanīyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ so upaṭṭhāpeti;
mn31:9.7: sacāssa hoti avisayhaṃ hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅgakena upaṭṭhāpema, na tv-eva mayaṃ bhante tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma.
mn31:9.8: Pañcāhikaṃ kho pana mayaṃ bhante sabbarattiyā dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdāma.
mn31:9.9: Evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante appamattā ātāpino pahitattā vīharāmāti.
mn31:10.2: Atthi pana vo Anuruddhā evaṃ appamattānaṃ ātāpīnaṃ pahitattānaṃ viharataṃ uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariya [ñāṇadassana] viseso adhigato phāsuvihāro ti. -- Kiṃ

mn31:10.5: Ayaṃ kho no bhante amhākaṃ appamattānaṃ ātāpīnaṃ pahitattānaṃ viharataṃ uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariya [ñāṇadassana]viseso adhigato phāsuvihāro ti. --

mn31:21.1: Atha kho Dīgho parajano yakkho yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Dīgho parajano yakkho Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn31:21.3: yatha Tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā,
mn31:21.4: āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo ti.
mn31:21.5: Dīghassa parajanassa yakkhassa saddaṃ sutvā bhummā devā saddamanussāvesuṃ:
mn31:21.6: Lābhā vata bho Vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā Vajjipajāya,
mn31:21.7: yattha Tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā,
mn31:21.8: āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo ti.
mn31:21.9: Bhummānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā Cātummahārājikā devā --pe--
mn31:21.16: Lābhā vata bho Vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā Vajjipajāya,
mn31:21.17: yattha Tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, ime ca tayo kulaputtā,
mn31:21.18: āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Nandiyo āyasmā ca Kimbilo ti.
mn31:21.19: Itiha te āyasmanto tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāva Brahmalokā viditā ahesuṃ.
mn31:22.2: Yasmā pi Dīgha kulā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, tañ-ca pi kulaṃ ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittaṃ anussareyya tassa p' assa kulassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.3: Yasmā pi Dīgha kulaparivaṭṭā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ so ce pi kulaparivaṭṭo ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassa p' assa kulaparivaṭṭassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.4: Yasmā pi Dīgha gāmā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, so ce pi gāmo ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassa p' assa gāmassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.5: Yasmā pi Dīgha nigamā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, so ce pi nigamo ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassa p' assa nigamassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.6: Yasmā pi Dīgha nagarā ete tayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, tañ-ce pi nagaraṃ ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittaṃ anussareyya tassa p' assa nagarassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.7: Yasmā pi Dīgha janapadā ete ayo kulaputtā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, so ce pi janapado ete tayo kulaputte pasannacitto anussareyya tassa p' assa janapadassa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.8: Sabbe ce pi Dīgha khattiyā ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittā anussareyyuṃ sabbesānaṃ p' assa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.9: Sabbe ce pi Dīgha brāhmaṇā ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittā anussareyyuṃ sabbesānaṃ p' assa brāhmaṇānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.10: Sabbe ce pi Dīgha vessā ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittā anussareyyuṃ sabbesānaṃ p' assa vessānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.11: Sabbe ce pi Dīgha suddā ete tayo kulaputtā pasannacittā anussareyyuṃ sabbesānaṃ p' assa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.12: Sadevako ce pi Dīgha loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā ete tayo kulaputte pasannacittā anussareyya sadevakassa p' assa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn31:22.13: Passa Dīgha yāva c' ete tayo kulaputtā bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya, atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan-ti.
mn31:22.15: Attamano Dīgho parajano yakkho Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 32.
